trechos.trecho: Every now and then, especially when I make reviews with the official iPhone Anki app, they are synchronized but no due dates are set and the review counter remains at 0
trechos.contexto: Relato de revisões sincronizadas sem ajuste de datas de vencimento

trechos.trecho: Both times, I reviewed 200+ cards using the official iPad app, synchronised the progress right after only to find all progress I made to be non-existent the next day.
trechos.contexto: Relatório de progresso desaparecendo após sincronização

trechos.trecho: Today I again noticed that cards that I reviewed yesterday were registered as 'reviewed', but no new due date was set for these.
trechos.contexto: Revisões registradas mas sem atualização de datas de vencimento

trechos.trecho: I am currently working towards a big exam and my cards are piling up because reviews are not properly registered.
trechos.contexto: Impacto direto em produtividade do usuário por falha de sincronização
